128/**
129 * @brief Build a @ref ModBotPrefab recipe into a flat @ref BotPrefab by resolving base and
130 * child paths. Recursively calls @ref IBotLoader loading methods for each path reference,
131 * supporting nested bots.
132 *
133 * @param buildParams The ModBotPrefab recipe to build the bot form.
134 * @param loader The IBotLoader implementation used to load nested bots.
135 * @param validate If true, validation checks will be performed after each modification is applied.
136 * If a modification loads another bot, it will be validated as well. Note that is entirely possible
137 * that BuildBot could result in a valid bot even if some intermediates are invalid. However, it is
138 * best practice to validate the entire chain of modifications.
139 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
140 */
141[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API BotPrefab BuildBot(
142 ModBotPrefab const& buildParams,
143 IBotLoader const& loader,
144 bool validate,
145 superdex::Error& error);

147/// Structured output from @ref Validate collecting per-element issues.
148struct ValidateResults {
149 /// If true, suppress MOCHI_LOG_WARNING calls during validation.
150 bool suppressWarnings = false;
151
152 /// Structural issues not tied to a specific link or joint.
153 DynamicArray<DynamicString> botIssues;
154
155 /// Per-link issues, indexed by link index (sized to numLinks by @ref Validate).
156 DynamicArray<DynamicArray<DynamicString>> linkIssues;
157
158 /// Per-joint issues, indexed by joint index (sized to numJoints by @ref Validate).
159 DynamicArray<DynamicArray<DynamicString>> jointIssues;
160};

172/**
173 * @brief Rebuild computed internal link data from the raw link and joint definitions.
174 *
175 * @details First sorts the incoming data via @ref SortBotPrefab to ensure canonical ordering
176 * (parents before children, siblings in alphanumeric order), then recomputes all internal data
177 *
178 * @param[in,out] botPrefab The bot parameters to rebuild (modified in place).
179 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
180 */
181MOCHI_API void RebuildBotData(BotPrefab& botPrefab, superdex::Error& error);
182
183/**
184 * @brief Sort bot link/joint/defaultPose data so that children follow their parents and siblings
185 * are ordered by alphanumeric (natural) comparison of link names.
186 *
187 * @details Performs a DFS pre-order traversal of the link tree, visiting siblings in alphanumeric
188 * order. The resulting permutation is applied to @ref BotPrefab::links, @ref BotPrefab::joints,
189 * and @ref BotPrefab::defaultPose. Does NOT recompute internal fields; the caller should follow
190 * with a call to @ref RebuildBotData.
191 *
192 * @note Called automatically by @ref RebuildBotData.
193 *
194 * @param[in,out] botPrefab Bot parameters to sort (modified in place).
195 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
196 */
197MOCHI_API void SortBotPrefab(BotPrefab& botPrefab, superdex::Error& error);

286/**
287 * @brief Compute and bake mass properties (centerOfMass, momentOfInertia) for links that specify
288 * mass or density but are missing explicit inertial data.
289 *
290 * @details For each link with a shape and mass/density but without centerOfMass or momentOfInertia,
291 * creates a temporary rigid actor to compute inertial properties from the mesh geometry. For
292 * density-only links, also computes mass = density * volume.
293 *
294 * @param[in,out] botPrefab Bot parameters to modify (mass properties written in place).
295 * @param[in] context Mochi context (used for shape loading and actor creation).
296 * @param[in] loader Bot loader used to load shape assets.
297 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
298 */
299MOCHI_API void BakeMassProperties(

301 Context* context,
302 IBotLoader const& loader,
303 superdex::Error& error);

323/**
324 * @brief Check whether contact between two links is implicitly disabled by Mochi's articulated
325 * actor creation, mirroring the rule in @ref Scene::CreateArticulatedActor.
326 *
327 * @details Contact is implicitly disabled between two links iff both have a shape file
328 * (@ref BotLinkPrefab::shapeFile) AND they are connected by a path through the link tree where
329 * every intermediate node is either shape-less, or the edge entering it is a @ref
330 * ArticulatedJointType::Hard joint. Direct parent-child pairs are a special case.
331 *
332 * Returns false if either link is out of range or shape-less.
333 *
334 * @param[in] botPrefab Bot describing the articulation.
335 * @param[in] linkA First link index.
336 * @param[in] linkB Second link index.
337 * @return True if contact is implicitly disabled by Mochi's default rule.
338 */
339[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API bool
340IsContactImplicitlyDisabled(BotPrefab const& botPrefab, int linkA, int linkB);

342/**
343 * @brief Convert a bot-space pose to an articulated-actor pose.
344 *
345 * @details Bot DOFs never include the root joint's, whether or not the articulation has any: a
346 * Free root contributes 6 actor DOFs that bot space excludes, and a Hard root contributes none.
347 * The two spaces therefore share an order and differ only by that leading offset, so this copies
348 * @p srcPose to @c pose[i + numBaseDofs] and zero-fills the base DOFs, producing the actor-DOF
349 * layout @ref Actor::SetArticulatedPoseFromJoints expects. It never permutes.
350 *
351 * @param[in] botPrefab Bot describing the articulation.
352 * @param[in] srcPose Bot-space pose (must have one entry per bot-space DOF).
353 * @param[in] numActorDofs The actor's DOF count (@ref Actor::GetNumDofs).
354 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
355 * @return Pose in actor-DOF layout, sized to @p numActorDofs.
356 */
357[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API DynamicArray<real> BuildArticulatedPoseFromBotPose(
358 BotPrefab const& botPrefab,
359 Span<real const> srcPose,
360 int numActorDofs,
361 superdex::Error& error);
362
363/// The kind of pose @ref MakeBotPose should produce.
364enum class MakeBotPoseType {
365 Zero, ///< All DOFs set to 0, then clamped to the joint's limits if present.
366 Min, ///< @c minLimit when present; otherwise the Random-fallback low (revolute/spherical 0,
367 ///< prismatic -1).
368 Max, ///< @c maxLimit when present; otherwise the Random-fallback high (revolute/spherical 2pi,
369 ///< prismatic +1).
370 Mid, ///< Midpoint `(lo+hi)/2` when both limits exist; otherwise 0 clamped to whichever side
371 ///< exists.
372 Random, ///< Uniform sample within `[lo, hi]`; fallback range when a limit is missing is
373 ///< [0, 2pi] for Revolute/Spherical and [-1, +1] for Prismatic.
374};
375
376/**
377 * @brief Produce a pose sized to the bot-space DOF count.
378 *
379 * @details For Revolute/Prismatic joints the scalar limit is computed via @c Dot(*limit, axis);
380 * for Spherical joints limits are treated per-component. See @ref MakeBotPoseType for the
381 * per-DOF rule each kind applies.
382 *
383 * @param[in] botPrefab The bot. @ref RebuildBotData should have been called first.
384 * @param[in] type Which kind of pose to produce.
385 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
386 * @return Pose vector with one entry per DOF, in the same order as @ref BotPrefab::defaultPose.
387 */
388[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API DynamicArray<real>
389MakeBotPose(BotPrefab const& botPrefab, MakeBotPoseType type, superdex::Error& error);
390
391/**
392 * @brief Extract a per-DOF effort-limit array from a bot: one entry per DOF in bot-space order
393 * (bot-space is mochi's DOF space excluding the base link's free DOFs, if present; a Spherical
394 * joint's @c effortLimit repeats across its 3 DOFs).
395 *
396 * @details Values pass through verbatim per @ref BotJointPrefab::effortLimit semantics: a negative
397 * value (default @ref kEffortUnbounded) is unbounded, @c 0 is non-actuated, and a positive value is
398 * a finite limit. Errors only if the prefab has not been rebuilt with @ref RebuildBotData. To
399 * source limits from a bot file, call @ref LoadBotPrefabFromFile first and pass the resulting
400 * prefab.
401 *
402 * @param[in] botPrefab A bot whose data has been rebuilt with @ref RebuildBotData.
403 * @param[in,out] error Error status.
404 * @return Per-DOF effort limits, or an empty array on error.
405 */
406[[nodiscard]] MOCHI_API DynamicArray<real> GetEffortLimitsPerDof(
407 BotPrefab const& botPrefab,
408 superdex::Error& error);
